ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and remind the driver that the $6.61 cancellation fee requires >3 consecutive minutes of waiting within the pickup radius after tapping "I'm Here".
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat (pickup notice, cancellation notice) and the driver's statement contain no threat, abuse, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the dispute type is no_show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

NS-0 routing: cancelled_by = driver and the driver asserts rider no-show, so the case is decided under NS-1/NS-2.

NS-1 conditions: (i) the driver did tap "I'm Here" at 09:54:15 (recorded in the timeline). (ii) At that tap the GPS fix is 09:54:00, lat 1.290535, lon 103.846149 — about 35 m from the Clarke Quay pickup (1.2906, 103.8465), well within the 200 m radius. So (ii) holds. (iii) fails: the driver was within 200 m from 09:54:00 until the 09:57:20 cancellation, i.e. only ~3 min 05 s of dwell from the first in-radius fix and ~3 min 05 s from the tap, and the policy requires strictly more than 3 minutes of continuous waiting after the tap (≥ 3:01). At the tap the elapsed wait was zero. The driver's own message at 09:57:10 ("Waited more than 3 min") and his statement ("waited more than 3 minutes") assert a wait the timestamps do not support: from 09:54:15 to 09:57:10 is 2 min 55 s. System/timeline records override the driver's statement, so the claimed 3-minute wait is not established.

There is no GPS gap: samples run every 30 s (thinned from a 5 s grid) through to 09:57:20, covering the cancellation moment, so RD-1/NS-1(iii) can be measured rather than presumed. The record carries no no_show_threshold_min field, so the NS-1 default of >3 minutes applies.

Result: NS-1 (iii) is not satisfied → NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full, refund_full, amount $6.61, issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7 (dispute filed 2026-09-17, same day, well inside 30 days). No flag_account: the driver's "I'm Here" tap was at the pickup point (≈35 m), so the NS-2 fraud flag (tap while outside the radius) is not triggered, and the driver-side no-show profile data cannot be used to decide or flag this case.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he waited more than 3 minutes after pressing "I'm Here". The timeline shows the tap at 09:54:15 and cancellation at 09:57:20 (~3:05), but the in-radius continuous wait computed from the records falls just under the >3:01 requirement of NS-1(iii); timestamps override the statement.
"Waited more than 3 min, cancelling" — the message itself was sent at 09:57:10, 2 min 55 s after the 09:54:15 tap, so it does not evidence a completed 3-minute wait.
